name: Intel iGPU · Software rendering fallback (Example)
author: ApkStart
description: Older Intel iGPUs (pre HD / UHD 6xx) may fail GLES initialization or experience visual corruption on certain driver versions. Pinning rendering backend to software guarantees display output.
name: Intel 核显 · 软件渲染兜底（示例）
author: ApkStart
description: 老款 Intel 核显（HD / UHD 6xx 之前）在部分驱动版本上会出现 GLES 初始化失败或花屏。把渲染后端固定为 software，画面一定能出来。

notes: Display output is guaranteed, but games will lag: these machines are better suited for lightweight apps
画面能出来但游戏会卡：这类机器更适合玩轻量应用
